claims.statement: Steam Engine preserves LG 18650HG2 3000mAh 20A as a 3000mAh preset with a 20A runtime rating.
Battery Mooch assessed this tested exact model at 20A continuous discharge.
LG HG2 is documented as an unprotected flat-top 18650 cell, approximately 18.3 mm x 65.0 mm.
LG 18650HG2 is documented as a lithium-ion cell with an NMC (Li[NiMnCo]O2) cathode and graphite-based anode.
The exact catalog entry LG 18650HG2 has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2015 or earlier.
